task:
Prepare DOM and implement the initial GSAP/Lenis motion layer.

Context:
This is the final step in our frontend & motion overhaul phase. We need to integrate GSAP (specifically ScrollTrigger) and Lenis for smooth scrolling, bringing the fluid.glass aesthetic to life.

Instructions:
1. Review the "Motion Layer Preparation" section in `docs/architecture/FLUID-GLASS-BENTO-SCHEMA.md`.
2. Wrap the necessary global layout elements (e.g., in `site/snippets/header.php` and `site/snippets/footer.php`, or wherever appropriate) to support Lenis smooth scrolling (usually requires a wrapper or just JS initialization).
3. Set up the JS entry point (e.g., `src/js/main.js` or equivalent) to initialize Lenis and register GSAP ScrollTrigger.
4. Implement the horizontal scroll logic using GSAP mapping for the `data-horizontal-scroll` elements we created in the previous step.
5. Signal completion using the `attempt_completion` tool with a concise summary.

These specific instructions supersede any conflicting general instructions. Work ONLY on the GSAP/Lenis motion layer integration.
